question: Which of the following continents is located entirely in the Southern Hemisphere?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Australia is the **smallest continent** and is located entirely within the Southern Hemisphere.
 
• It is surrounded by the Indian Ocean to the west and south and the Pacific Ocean to the east.
 
• Australia is unique as it is the only continent that is also a country, referred to as the Commonwealth of Australia.
 
• Its geographical position ensures that all of its landmass lies south of the Equator.
 
• Major cities in Australia include Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, and Adelaide, all located in the Southern Hemisphere.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Southern Hemisphere:** The portion of Earth south of the Equator; includes continents such as Australia, Antarctica, parts of South America, and Africa.
 
• **Equator:** An imaginary line around the Earth, equidistant from the North and South Poles, dividing the planet into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
 
• **Unique Flora and Fauna:** Australia is known for its endemic species, including kangaroos, koalas, and eucalyptus trees, which are adapted to its specific climatic conditions.
 
• **Climate Zones:** Australia features diverse climate zones ranging from tropical in the north, desert in the center, and temperate in the south.
 
• **Great Barrier Reef:** Located off the northeastern coast of Australia, it is the world's largest coral reef system and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
